verdict: Personio: Choose Personio when EU GDPR-native core HRIS with a published euro PEPM floor is the job — not when you need US payroll, published USD PEPM, or frontline WFM. Scores use the HR editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing.
strengths: Time tracking and preliminary payroll on Core
bestFor: EU-headquartered or EU-heavy teams that need GDPR-native HRIS
Companies comparing Personio as the European BambooHR analogue
Orgs that can commit to annual Core and add Recruiting/Payroll apps later
notIdealFor: US-only payroll-first buyers (Gusto) or HR+IT unification (Rippling)
Frontline WFM or dedicated ATS as the primary purchase
Buyers who need a published USD PEPM like BambooHR Core $10
tradeoffs: Published free tiers vs paid depth for ATS, WFM, time, or training jobs
Hub / multi-module pricing complexity vs single-product floors
Mobile/frontline readiness vs desk-bound admin depth
Opaque contact-sales pricing vs transparent published seats
recommendation: Choose Personio when EU GDPR-native core HRIS with a published euro PEPM floor is the job — not when you need US payroll, published USD PEPM, or frontline WFM. Compare HiBob for culture-forward mid-market UX, BambooHR for US published PEPM, Rippling for HR+IT, and Workday for enterprise HCM.
editorialNotes: HR Priority-2 batch. Approved on hr-editorial v1.0.0. membershipRole=primary. jobCluster=hris-core. handsOnTesting=false. Affiliate economics excluded.

criterionAssessments.rationale: EU SMB/mid HRIS with a published Core EUR floor is approachable versus Workday. Not lab-tested.
Primary job is GDPR-native core HRIS. Scored inside hris-core; recruiting is an App, not the core job.
Researched time-attendance supported plus ATS/career modules as add-ons — deeper European HRIS workflow packaging than BambooHR’s US-leaning add-on payroll/time shape.
European payroll/accounting connectors plus collaboration apps are adequate.
Employee self-serve exists; not deskless WFM.
Core analytics plus App surveys/performance — adequate, not HiBob culture-analytics depth.
Vendor claims ~10–5,000 employees; CorePro entities/API support mid-market growth.
Quote-led European packaging lacks a verified public PEPM floor versus BambooHR’s published starting price.
In-product AI agents are marketed in 2026 without a separate public SKU — useful but not Ashby-class ATS AI.

overallScoreRationale: Weighted average of the nine HR editorial criteria using the category weights (hiring/workforce fit 15, workflow depth 14, ease of use 12, integrations 12, value 12, mobile/frontline 10, scalability 9, analytics 8, AI 8), rounded to 1 decimal. Products are scored inside their job cluster — ATS, core HRIS, payroll/benefits, people-platform, frontline WFM, time & attendance, SOP training, and LMS peers are not forced into one undifferentiated ranking. Not a hands-on lab score, and affiliate economics are excluded.
